name: unpaged
description: Unpaged plugins for Claude Code: the plan Claude just made, rendered as a whiteboard your team can navigate and comment on, with @agent comments delivered automatically to the session — and, when the code is done, the as-built record of what shipped and why, nested under the plan. Plus the repository's architecture document, drawn from the code and kept in step with it: after every pull request the session opens, the line above the prompt says whether the document still holds.

plugins.name: unpaged
plugins.description: Turn Claude Code plans into whiteboards on Unpaged — review on the canvas, comment on the pieces (@agent comments are delivered automatically to the session by a listener inside Claude Code, with a line above the prompt showing what it listens to, for every canvas the session creates or changes, a plan or not, where your permission rules let it create listener keys; otherwise the agent offers to listen), approval flips the canvas to executing; the session keeps a Decision log while it builds, and /unpaged:as-built compiles the record of what shipped and why under the plan. Every plan is filed in a Visual plans folder. /unpaged:architecture draws the repository's architecture document from its code; after every pull request the session opens, the plugin compares the two and the line above the prompt turns green or yellow, with update to rewrite what no longer holds.
